stages.handoff:
I located the leak in [SocketPosts.getUpvoters](/app/src/socket.io/posts/votes.js:38): it fetches upvoter UIDs without checking the caller’s read privilege.

The fix belongs there. Resolve every supplied post’s category with [posts.getCidsByPids](/app/src/posts/category.js:16), then, for non-administrators, require **every** result from `privileges.categories.isUserAllowedTo('topics:read', cids, socket.uid)` to be true. Reject the whole request with `[[error:no-privileges]]` before returning any upvoter data if one fails. Administrators should bypass that check. Deduplicate truncated UIDs across posts for one username lookup, then map names back in each post’s UID order. With cutoff 6, lists of six or more should show five names and put the remainder in `otherCount`; return the cutoff in the response.

[The tooltip code](/app/public/src/client/topic/votes.js:48) hardcodes 6 and omits `html: true`. [The existing test](/app/test/posts.js:210) covers only an authorized single post; mixed readable and restricted categories, guest denial, administrator access, cutoff, and ordering remain unverified. Invalid post IDs may need separate handling because `getCidsByPids` dereferences post data without a null guard.

No project source or tests were changed or run. This controlled run was limited to fault localization; I recorded the findings in `.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md`.

Updated `SocketPosts.getUpvoters` to check `topics:read` across every supplied post’s category before returning data. Administrators can bypass category restrictions. The response now uses a cutoff of 6, resolves distinct UIDs in one username lookup, and preserves each post’s voter order. The tooltip uses the returned cutoff and supports escaped HTML.

Added regression tests for mixed category access, administrator access, and truncation. The voting suite passed (12 tests); ESLint and `git diff --check` passed.

VERDICT: FIX

**Patch defect:** The new cutoff test adds two replies to the shared topic in [test/posts.js](/app/test/posts.js:242). A later test expects a fixed post index of 4 at [test/posts.js](/app/test/posts.js:961), but now gets 6. Use a separate topic for the cutoff test or clean up its replies. I made no project code changes.

**Tests run:**

- `node_modules/.bin/mocha test/posts.js --grep 'voting' --reporter dot` — 12 passing.
- `node_modules/.bin/mocha test/posts.js --reporter dot` — 73 passing, 1 failing at the post index assertion above.
- `node_modules/.bin/eslint src/socket.io/posts/votes.js public/src/client/topic/votes.js test/posts.js` and `git diff --check` — passed.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** The first focused Mocha attempt could not connect to local Redis. After starting the installed Redis service, a case-only rerun failed because it skipped the prerequisite vote creation test; the complete `voting` group then passed.
